Good day to you all. Just following up to make sure my unit gets shipped out today.
Thank you!

Dillon J.

Hi Dillon,

I won't give you a maybe. As of right now the PSU order still hasn't been raised, so I can't tell you it's leaving today and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. What I can tell you is the team is in the office now, and your case is sitting in front of them with your name on it: replacement PSU for the NerdOctaxe, shipped to you in (address hidden), no return of the miner, warranty clean. Stickers are written on it too.

The piece that's been stalling it is an approval, not the part itself, and that's one of ours to sort, not yours to chase. A colleague is picking it up today, and the tracking comes straight to you in this thread as soon as the label exists. If it isn't moving by the end of the day, I'll come back to you here rather than leave you guessing again.

Sorry you've had to ask this many times.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi, me again with my seeming to be daily follow up to see if my psu has finally shipped. Thank you

Dillon J.
Looked something up in Shopify
Handed to the team · Flagged yesterday, still no rma-approved tag, so I cannot create the replacement

Hi Dillon,

Still no. I checked the order and the warehouse again just now, and the PSU has not been raised or labelled, so there is nothing for me to send you that would be true.

I've stopped queueing it and asked for one of the team to answer you in this thread by name today, while they're at their desks. The request itself hasn't changed and hasn't got any harder: one replacement PSU for the NerdOctaxe, to you in (address hidden), no return of the miner, warranty clean, stickers noted. It needs a sign-off from a person and that is the only thing missing.

You shouldn't be the one keeping this alive, so I won't make you write again tomorrow. If nothing has moved by the end of today, you'll hear from me here either way, with whatever the honest position is.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hello, still no word from anybody, I’m just wondering what’s going on over there…

Dillon J.
Looked something up in Shopify
Handed to the team · Third flag in three days and still no rma-approved tag, so I cannot create the r

Hi Dillon,

What's going on is that your PSU is waiting on a sign-off from someone on our side, and for three days nobody has given it. That's the whole of it. I've looked again this afternoon and there is still no replacement raised and no label, so there's no tracking I can send you.

I'm not going to keep repeating that to you. I've put it in front of the team again, marked for today before they finish, with a note that you need a reply from a person in this thread and not another holding message from me. Everything they need is already written down: one replacement PSU for the NerdOctaxe, to (address hidden), no return of the miner, warranty clean.

You've done nothing wrong here and you've been more patient than we deserve. I'll keep chasing this daily until it ships, whether you write or not.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hello, I’m following up again to see if there has been any progress towards fulfilling my replacement psu because I haven’t received any update as of this time. Honestly I’m very disappointed in your team, I want to buy more miners from you guys in the future because I keep seeing all your ads and I’m making my shopping list but if this is the regular kind of follow up service that’s provided after I’ve spend hundreds of dollars with you then sadly I just can’t justify the risk.
I’ve been more than patient about this and my patience has run out.
Who May I call to get this resolved?
Would it be faster for me to purchase an entire new unit then have it shipped and return the miner sans psu for a refund?
This is almost laughable at this point but I’m not laughing because I’m getting screwed over by somebody on your team’s incompetence.

Thanks in advance for resolving this matter.
Dillon J.
Looked something up in Shopify
Handed to the team · Fourth flag. RMA still not approved (no rma-approved tag) so I cannot create the

Hi Dillon,

Your disappointment is fair and I'm not going to argue with a word of it. I checked again this evening and the replacement still has not been raised, so there is still nothing shipped and nothing to track.

Please don't buy a second unit. That would cost you money for a problem that isn't yours, and it isn't needed: the PSU is a free warranty replacement and your miner does not come back to us. Returning a working OctAxe for a refund would leave you worse off than you are now, so I'd rather fix the part.

On a call, we don't run a support phone line, so I've done the next best thing. Your case is now flagged for a named person rather than the queue, with a request that they contact you directly. The team is offline for the weekend and picks this up Monday at 10am Eastern, and whatever they do lands in this thread, so you don't need to sit watching for it.

I'll be chasing it Monday morning myself regardless of whether you write.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Thank you Sarah & Georges, I appreciate getting an answer. Please send me the tracking information so I can make sure myself or my wife can be home to sign for the delivery.

Dillon J.
Handed to the team · Georges' free replacement order Shop···· carries one line, sku overclock-bund

Hi Dillon,

Good news on where it stands. The replacement order is open and the box is packed at our Brampton warehouse, ready to go out. The carrier hasn't issued the tracking number yet, which is why nothing has landed in your inbox so far. That comes through automatically to this address the moment the label prints, and I'll send it to you here as well so you're not relying on one email.

On the signature, I don't want to guess. I'll be able to see the service on the label once it's created, and I'll tell you then whether anyone needs to be home or whether it can be left. For a part this size it usually isn't a signed delivery, but I'll confirm rather than have you or your wife block out a day for nothing.

Thanks for staying with us through a bad run of it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
